scope: Selected Z3 stage entry/source inventory; not a completed nested producer or shape transfer

stages.name: inline_trivial
stages.existing_Paxiom_effect: decl_map can reconstruct the same prsymbol using t_replace_all; returned representatives affect later environment bodies
stages.remaining: Stored mapper/environment/representative transfer for the four unresolved formula families.

stages.name: eliminate_builtin
stages.existing_Paxiom_effect: Drop a tagged axiom or retain the same declaration object
stages.remaining: Actual metadata/drop decisions may reduce later producers; no formula reconstruction for existing axioms here.

stages.name: remove_unused
stages.existing_Paxiom_effect: Removal walk retains selected tdecls with Task.add_tdecl
stages.remaining: Goal-dependent retention does not itself bound other stages' candidate formulas.

stages.name: detect_polymorphism
stages.existing_Paxiom_effect: Inspect declarations and optionally insert metadata; original goal/context declarations retained
stages.remaining: Actual monomorphic-only flag is not derived in this packet; later conditional branches remain open.

stages.name: eliminate_inductive
stages.existing_Paxiom_effect: Existing Dprop passes unchanged; Dind clauses reuse their own prsymbols and inversion axioms use fresh heads
stages.remaining: Freshness/known-map declaration identity premises separate clause keys from existing Paxiom keys.

stages.name: eliminate_algebraic_if_poly
stages.existing_Paxiom_effect: Either full algebraic rewriting or compile_match plus projection rewriting can rebuild existing Paxioms
stages.remaining: Select actual branch and bound resulting stored forms; absence of cases in raw targets alone does not classify earlier inlining output.

stages.name: eliminate_literal
stages.existing_Paxiom_effect: decl_map_fold reconstructs existing keys; generated literal axioms have fresh prsymbols
stages.remaining: Actual literal/type metadata and preceding stored inputs still need transfer.

stages.name: eliminate_gnatprove_guard_epsilon
stages.existing_Paxiom_effect: decl_map (lift_q polarity) reconstructs goal and Paxiom keys, including local assumption insertion
stages.remaining: Bound stored forms, especially argument__post_axiom's epsilon-bearing input.

stages.name: eliminate_epsilon
stages.existing_Paxiom_effect: decl_map_fold reconstructs existing keys; additional lifted axioms use fresh heads
stages.remaining: Bound all prior same-key candidates, even when later epsilon removal prevents final equality.

stages.name: introduce_premises
stages.existing_Paxiom_effect: Existing context is retained, but goals may reconstruct axioms using introduced_prsymbol metadata; a separate name/content Hsdecl can return old declaration objects
stages.remaining: Do not assume all resulting heads are fresh. Classify actual introduced_prsymbol metadata and this local representative table's returning-key relation.

stages.name: simplify_formula
stages.existing_Paxiom_effect: Trans.rewriteTF reconstructs existing keys using propositional and quantifier simplifiers
stages.remaining: Can make the same logical pruning/if-true rewrites as CE; strict-equal stored forms still need producer closure.

stages.name: discriminate_if_poly
stages.existing_Paxiom_effect: Identity when monomorphic-only is present; otherwise one instantiation retains the prsymbol, multiple instantiations use fresh heads
stages.remaining: Actual metadata guard, substitution and returned-representative transfer not established.

stages.name: encoding_smt_if_poly
stages.existing_Paxiom_effect: Identity when monomorphic-only is present; otherwise selected encoding subpasses must be analyzed
stages.remaining: Actual flag selection and nested same-key producer/shape closure remain unproved.

other_pre_first_fill_roots: CVC5 and Alt-Ergo partial CE computations can construct their same deterministic raw-key CE candidates before successful memo installation.

Driver lookup/library initialization can precede CE; inherited fresh-head/source relation excludes newly parsed/cloned heads from old physical Paxiom keys, while reused objects remain part of the initial/continuing table.
Metadata-only update retains logical declarations under the accepted task/cache relation; goals use Decl.Hsdecl.unique.
Selected save/report callbacks do not schedule an independent logical producer under the existing serial pending-ownership relation; their direct registration/capacity charge is separate.
